references.text: Moses performs the anointing of the tabernacle and its furnishings as God commanded in Exodus 30:26
Description of the ark of the testimony (ארון העדת) to be anointed
Description of the tent of meeting (אהל מועד) to be anointed with the holy oil
Parallel command to anoint the altar to consecrate it
Moses anoints the tabernacle and everything in it, including Aaron, with the anointing oil
Reference to when Moses had set up the tabernacle and anointed and consecrated it with all its utensils
The New Testament refers to the tent of meeting and the ark of the testimony as part of the sanctuary of the first covenant
Both verses describe components of the same holy oil and incense ritual that is to be placed before the testimony.
Complementary instructions on anointing to consecrate various parts of the tabernacle's furnishings.
Describes respectively the making and the subsequent anointing of the ark of the testimony.
Connects the contents of the ark (God's word) with the consecration of the object itself through anointing.
Lists the specific elements that are subject to anointing and consecration in the source verse.
Describes the construction of the ark which then becomes the object of anointing in the source verse.
